title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program: Plan Schedule and Monthly Tuition
content:
The Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program offers six monthly-tuition plans. Each plan is defined by the care session it covers, the number of program days per school week, the grades it admits, the campuses where it operates, its opening and closing times and its standard monthly tuition. Standard monthly tuition is the amount per billing month, August through May, before any rate-basis or sibling discount.

## Plan schedule

| Plan | Standard monthly tuition (USD) | Session covered | Program days per week | Grades admitted | Before-school care opens | After-school care closes, pickup due |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Creek Kids Club After-School Care (2 Days) | 128.00 | after-school | 2 | KG, 01, 02, 03, 04, 05 | not offered | 18:00 |
| Creek Kids Club Before-School Care (5 Days) | 142.00 | before-school | 5 | KG, 01, 02, 03, 04, 05 | 06:45 | not offered |
| Creek Kids Club After-School Care (3 Days) | 176.00 | after-school | 3 | KG, 01, 02, 03, 04, 05 | not offered | 18:00 |
| Creek Kids Club After-School Care (5 Days) | 248.00 | after-school | 5 | KG, 01, 02, 03, 04, 05 | not offered | 18:00 |
| Creek Kids Club Before & After-School Care (5 Days) | 326.00 | before and after | 5 | KG, 01, 02, 03, 04, 05 | 06:45 | 18:00 |
| Creek Kids Club Pre-K Wraparound Care (5 Days) | 384.00 | before and after | 5 | PK3, PK4 | 06:45 | 18:00 |

Times are on the 24-hour clock. Grades are the grade codes on the district enrollment record.

## Campuses served

| Plan | Campuses where the plan operates |
|---|---|
| The five kindergarten-through-grade-5 plans (After-School 2 Days, Before-School 5 Days, After-School 3 Days, After-School 5 Days, Before & After-School 5 Days) | Alder Springs Elementary, Bluebonnet Trail Elementary, Cypress Hollow Elementary, Live Oak Elementary, Pecan Grove Elementary |
| Creek Kids Club Pre-K Wraparound Care (5 Days) | Sunflower Early Childhood Center, Cypress Hollow Elementary, Pecan Grove Elementary |

## Reading the schedule

- The after-school plans and the two before-and-after plans close at 18:00. The Before-School Care (5 Days) plan has no after-school session, so it has no close time for pickup.
- A plan of two program days per week is the After-School Care (2 Days) plan, and the After-School Care (3 Days) plan is the only plan of three days. Every other plan runs five program days per week.
- Pre-kindergarten students (PK3, PK4) can hold only the Pre-K Wraparound plan. Kindergarten through grade 5 students can hold any of the other five plans at the five elementary campuses.
